requirement: When a component on an aircraft needs replacing, a maintainer requests the replacement against one of that aircraft's maintenance events. A maintenance lead other than the requester approves it, and only then is a work order opened and assigned; if the work order cannot finish, it is closed again. Viewers can see the fleet's components and aircraft without their maintenance status, and cannot request a replacement or open a work order. Someone not signed in sees nothing. - The workflow is `airforce.ReplaceComponent`, with inputs `componentId`, `maintenanceEventId` and `assignTo` (the work order's assignee). - Its approval step is `leadApproval`. - A request whose component and maintenance event are on different aircraft fails.
author: maintainer
